notes.title: User interface update
notes.notes:
- Add Material Icons by Google 

- Replace a lot of text with icons 

- More intuitive interface

- Reduce the number of runtime librairies to avoid compatibility issues (use stb_image instead of FreeImage, stb_truetype instead of FreeType) 

- Change Windows compiler from Visual C++ to g++ 

Édgimon is still planned to be released this year: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2763090/dgimon/
